how.title: Four steps to the first conversation.

0.title: Add your website
0.body: Enter your URL — the system starts learning your content.

1.title: AI learns the business
1.body: Services, FAQs, documents, and business info become the knowledge base.

industries.title: Built for Latvian service businesses.
industries.subtitle: Especially useful when customers ask about prices and want to book.

pricing.title: Start free. Scale when demand grows.
pricing.subtitle: Clear conversation limits. BUSINESS is the recommended plan for most companies.

0.q: Do I need to know how to code?
0.a: No. You add your website, configure the assistant in the dashboard, and paste one ready-made snippet.

1.q: How quickly can I set it up?
1.a: A first version is usually ready the same day: registration, crawl, and widget code take minutes, not weeks.

2.a: Yes. The assistant is built for Latvian and English — with optional automatic language matching.

3.q: Will it work with my website?
3.a: Yes, if you can paste a script (WordPress, Webflow, custom HTML, and more). The widget is small and CMS-agnostic.

4.q: Can I control what the AI says?
4.a: Yes. You set tone, restricted topics, greetings, fallbacks, and knowledge sources. Answers are grounded in your content.

5.a: Yes. Cancel from the dashboard; access continues until the end of the paid period.
